name: Maxxus Serenity 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna
description: Maxxus MX-LS2-01 2-Person Infrared Sauna Do you want to live a long and healthy life? Honor your body and mind by giving yourself a healthier lifestyle. Take a break from the busy home and work life to reap the benefits of an infrared sauna! Maxxus Saunas use infrared waves to penetrate into your body tissue and can help dissolve harmful substances and toxins. The FAR infrared waves can penetrate the deepest into the tissue to help break down toxins as you perspire and wipe them away. Maxxus Saunas are constructed of Canadian reforested Hemlock Wood . These saunas also feature Low EMF heating panels, MP3 Aux connection for music, clear glass, and interior reading lights. Add in environmentally friendly reforested wood and energy-efficient carbon heating panels and you can’t find a better product for a healthier lifestyle. Every Maxxus Sauna is equipped with a floor and lower bench heater that gets the benefits and treatment to your legs and feet too. Help not only yourself but others with your infrared sauna purchase. What are you waiting for? Order your infrared sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference. Features Carbon infrared heating panels are energy-efficient and can heat up your sauna faster than ceramic panels. Still have that podcast to finish up? Plug your phone into the MP3/Aux input and listen to it on the two speakers while you rid your body of toxins and relax inside the sauna. Find your best temperature and time by adjusting the LED control panel. As you get accustomed to the sauna, you can gradually increase either one. Specifications Capacity: Full 2-person capacity Heating Elements: Maxxus Low EMF (EMF between 6-10MG - 6 to 8 inches from the heating panels) - Combination of 6 - Ceramic and Carbon Tech Low EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heaters (1 Ceramic and 5 Carbon Heating Panels) Wood Type: Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Glass: Clear Tempered glass door and with side Windows Interior Lighting: Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System Control Panels: Interior LED control panel Sound System: Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Electrical: Electrical service: 120 V/15 AMP Non GFCI plug & play (Recommend Dedicated Outlet) Dimensions: 75" H X 48" W X 40" L Sauna weight: 275 Ship weight: 335 Ships in 2 boxes. All Maxxus Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. Useful Link Download Assembly & Operation Manual Videos
